verdict.rationale: Ubuntu's official desktop documentation includes first-party guides to install NVIDIA drivers, build your own NVIDIA kernel modules with DKMS, and troubleshoot NVIDIA GPUs, so the core of the story is delivered. The evidence covers only one GPU vendor and only NVIDIA-specific module builds, and consists of doc titles rather than detailed content. Missing for 10: drivers for other GPU vendors (AMD/Intel), general custom kernel module building beyond the NVIDIA DKMS path, detailed doc content, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install GPU vendor drivers and build custom kernel modules for accelerated workloads
